#!/usr/bin/env perl use strict; use warnings; use feature 'say'; # a comment my $name = "pier"; my @items = (1, 2, 3); my %map = (name => 'pier', count => 42); my $ref = { key => 'value' }; =pod A block comment. =cut sub describe { my ($label, $count) = @_; my $interp = "name=$name count=$count"; my $raw = 'single quoted'; my $qq = qq{interpolated $name}; my $re = qr/[a-z]+\/[0-9]{2}/i; my $match = $label =~ m/(\w+)/; (my $sub = $label) =~ s/\s+/_/g; (my $tr = $label) =~ tr/a-z/A-Z/; my $num = 0x1f + 0b1010 + 1.5e-3; say $interp, $raw, $qq, $re, $match, $sub, $tr, $num; return $label; } describe($name, 42);
